items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: They had a guy named Bobby Scott playing second (inaudible).

ctx.x: What I want you to do, do you hear those white trumpet players when they play jazz, like Red Nichols and (inaudible) they play around the melody. That's what I want you to do, what none of those guys do; they play something else. So that's what I want you to do, develop the very, start simple, you fool around with the melody, just little bit, jazz around the melody. Don't try to do that hard stuff because you won't outdo them.

They had a guy named Bobby Scott playing second (inaudible). He said, you aren't going to outdo those guys. So try to get a start like that. I've got three different styles in my trumpet section, and I'll be able to work my music different ways. All right, great.
